notes.title: Run From the Hunt is going to be Free to Play!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’ve officially made Run From the Hunt free to play![/p][p]This was one of my first indie projects under LilithGuild, and I’m making it free so more people can enjoy it.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting my early work and feel free to share it with others![/p][p]– Lino[/p]
